gloss: outside Tokyo; outside the metropolitan area

definitions.gloss: outside Tokyo; outside the metropolitan area
definitions.explanation: Areas outside Tokyo Metropolis, used in administrative, news, and everyday contexts when distinguishing between inside and outside the capital.

examples.japanese: {都外|とがい}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す。
{都外|とがい}からの{通勤|つうきん}は{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: Commuting from outside Tokyo takes time.

examples.japanese: {在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}の{普及|ふきゅう}で{都外|とがい}に{住|す}む{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: With the spread of remote work, more people are living outside Tokyo.

notes:
Composed of {都|と} (metropolis, specifically Tokyo) + {外|がい} (outside). Follows the same pattern as {都内|とない} (inside Tokyo). The {都|と} in this word specifically refers to {東京都|とうきょうと} (Tokyo Metropolis), not to any other city.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都外|とがい}に{住|す}む: to live outside Tokyo
- {都外|とがい}からの{通勤|つうきん}: commuting from outside Tokyo
- {都外|とがい}{移転|いてん}: relocation outside Tokyo

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {都内|とない}: inside Tokyo — the opposite; refers to areas within Tokyo Metropolis
- {郊外|こうがい}: suburbs — refers to outlying areas of any city, not specifically Tokyo
- {県外|けんがい}: outside the prefecture — the equivalent term for prefectures other than Tokyo
